task: Viết Kudos (feature #12, VI/EN): Widget quick-action menu and Thể lệ panel on Homepage, Awards Information and Sun* Kudos; Viết Kudo modal (recipient autocomplete, Danh hiệu, rich-text editor with Add link and @mention, hashtag picker, image upload, anonymous) backed by create_kudo and kudos_search_sunners RPCs and a kudo-images Storage bucket
acceptanceCriteria: clicking the Widget on /, /awards-information and /sun-kudos opens the quick-action menu with Thể lệ, Viết KUDOS and a close button; close or Esc collapses it
Thể lệ opens the rules panel with Figma copy, 4 hero badges and 6 icons; Đóng closes it and Viết KUDOS in the panel opens the Viết Kudo modal
the compose pill on /sun-kudos opens the Viết Kudo modal; a guest on / choosing Viết KUDOS is sent to /login

the modal shows Người nhận, Danh hiệu, editor, Hashtag, Image and the anonymous checkbox (unchecked) in Figma order with Hủy and Gửi; Gửi stays disabled until recipient, title, content and at least one hashtag are filled, and each required field shows its error after blur

recipient search suggests up to 10 Sunners accent-insensitively, trims input, excludes the current user, and selecting one fills the field; typing @ in the editor suggests colleagues and inserts a mention
editor toolbar applies bold, italic, strike, numbered list, quote and inserts links through the Add link dialog (Text 1-100 non-blank, Link http/https 5-2048)

hashtags come only from the DB catalog, max 5 (remaining rows disabled), chips removable; images accept jpg/png/webp up to 5 MB, max 5 with + Image hidden at 5, thumbnails removable, other formats show an invalid-format error

Gửi validates on the server with zod, uploads images to kudo-images under an identity-free object name owned by the sender (owner_id), calls create_kudo, removes uploaded images when the RPC fails, closes the modal on success and the new Kudo appears at the top of the /sun-kudos feed; Hủy closes and discards

create_kudo takes the sender from auth.uid(), rejects non-allowed accounts, self-recipient, out-of-range title/content, 0 or more than 5 or unknown hashtags, images outside the sender folder or not in storage, and alias when not anonymous; kudos_search_sunners never returns email; both are executable by authenticated only
every new string switches between VI and EN; the existing unit and E2E suites stay green
blastRadius: homepage is public: reading the session for the widget must not break guest rendering
shared fake Supabase server used by every authed E2E spec
Server Action body size limit and proxy body limit in next.config.ts
Worker bundle size (Tiptap must stay client-only)
All Kudos feed client state after router.refresh
Dictionary type shared by all pages
contracts: RPC create_kudo(p_recipient_id uuid, p_title text, p_content text, p_hashtag_slugs text[], p_image_urls text[], p_is_anonymous boolean, p_anonymous_name text) returns uuid
RPC kudos_search_sunners(p_query text, p_limit int default 10) returns setof (id, full_name, avatar_url, department)
Storage bucket kudo-images, object path {uuid}.{jpg|png|webp} (no sender id in the path), ownership via storage.objects.owner_id
existing read RPCs kudos_feed / kudos_highlight / kudos_spotlight unchanged
